extracted.intended_audience: scientists, academics, educators, and applicants for academic posts and scholarships (primarily UK institutions)
extracted.subtask_description: Classifieds and institutional announcements listing academic posts, scholarships, and appointments with stated eligibility, duties, application materials, deadlines, and remuneration. Mostly UK university/college recruitment and scholarship notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Scholarship eligibility (University College, Nottingham)
rubrics_metrics.description: Open to any graduate of a British University. Candidates will be required to give evidence of suitable training and capacity for conducting on original research. The successful candidate will be required to devote himself to some subject of research to be approved of by the Senate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scholarship tenable for one year, value given (£35) together with free admission to the College. Applications to be sent not later than SEPTEMBER 1 on forms obtainable from the Registrar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entrance Medical Scholarships selection (University of Manchester & Manchester Royal Infirmary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two Scholarships are offered and will be awarded to candidates who give evidence of a high standard of proficiency in Arts or Science respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each scholarship is of the value of £100; successful candidates will be required to enter for the full Medical Curriculum in the University and the Infirmary. Applications should be sent on or before July 1 to the Registrar (further particulars from the Registrar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Guy's Hospital Entrance Scholarships eligibility (age and subject limits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two open scholarships in Arts: one of the value of £100 open to candidates under 30 years of age, and one of £50 open to candidates under 21 years. Two open scholarships in Science: one of the value of £150 and another of £60, open to candidates under 25 years of age. One open scholarship for University Students who have completed their Study of Anatomy and Physiology of the value of £10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Full particulars may be obtained on application to the Dean, Guy's Hospital. Candidates must meet the stated age and prior-study conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bedford College Research Scholarship in Chemistry (women-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council offer a RESEARCH SCHOLARSHIP in CHEMISTRY of the value of £30 for the Session 1907-8 only. Applications from women only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should be sent by July 1 to the Principal; further information obtainable from the Principal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal, Technical School selection criteria (Barrow-in-Furness)
rubrics_metrics.description: The gentleman appointed will be required to undertake, under the direction of the Director of Education, the organisation, equipment and management of all departments of the Technical School, to take part in the induction there given, and to advise, when required, on the preparatory technical work undertaken in the Evening Continuation Schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should furnish particulars of professional and technical training, experience in teaching and organisation, together with copies of three recent testimonials, references, etc., and be forwarded on or before the stated closing date (address and contact to Director of Education). Salary and further inquiries available from the Town Clerk/Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professor of Mining application requirements (University College of South Wales)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council of the College invites applications for the post of PROFESSOR of MINING at the annual salary of £600.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One hundred copies of applications, together with testimonials, must be sent on or before Tuesday, July 11, 1907. Further particulars may be obtained from the Registrar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kelly College headmaster religious eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: By the terms of the scheme, the Headmaster must be a member of the Church of England, but it is not required that he should be in Holy Orders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications and particulars to be sent to the Clerk to the Trustees by the stated deadline (Friday, July 5). Notice gives endowment and facilities of the post.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engineering lecturer/demonstrator qualifications (University College, Bristol)
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must have gone through a complete University course in engineering and have also had some practical experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Further particulars available from the undersigned; applications, accompanied by testimonials, should be sent on or before July 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistant Bacteriologist duties and application requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Required to undertake the examination of waters and sewages. He will also be required to assist in the diagnosis of disease, such as Diphtheria, Tubercle, Typhoid, Anthrax, &c. Salary £150 per annum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications, with two recent testimonials, to be sent not later than July 1, 1907, to the County Analyst (Shirehall, Worcester).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistant Mistress qualifications (Rhyl County School)
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree or equivalent; High Classics and English; German. Disciplinarian. Experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commencing salary £100 per annum. Applicants to state special subjects; apply before July 9 to the Headmaster, giving particulars of qualifications and experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application materials and testimonial requirements (various institutions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many notices require specific application documentation such as forms, records of experience, and multiple copies of testimonials (examples: 'Applications, along with 15 copies of testimonials' — University of Aberdeen; 'copies of three recent testimonials' — Barrow; '100 copies of applications... and testimonials' — University College of South Wales).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should follow each advert's stated submission instructions (number of copies, addressed official, and deadline). Some posts require stamped addressed envelopes to obtain forms or particulars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age eligibility limits for scholarships and posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Several scholarships specify upper age limits for eligibility (examples from Guy's Hospital: Arts scholarships 'under 30 years' and 'under 21 years'; Science scholarships 'under 25 years').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must meet the stated age requirements for the specific award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lecturer duties specification (e.g., Agricultural Chemistry, Harris Institute)
rubrics_metrics.description: Duties described: to give instruction in theoretical and practical Agricultural Chemistry, to undertake Agricultural Analytical work, and to assist in the general work of the Chemistry Department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Salary stated (£150); applications to be sent to the undersigned on or before July 1 (forms and further particulars obtainable from the Secretary/Registrar).
